workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute or longer slots they both have free next week:

Mon: 9:00-10:00
Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00

Could you please check Elena's and David's calendars and let me know which of these times work for them? Thanks.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. The only time from your list that works for all four of us is Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00. Please book the 30-minute meeting for that time. Thanks.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, thanks Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's over to you to send the confirmation email.

emails.body: Dear Partners, this email confirms a 30-minute meeting for the four of you has been booked for Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00 Eastern.
